This is consistent with the system's explicit instructions to 'avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.' The coordination is transparent among all participants, there is no secrecy, no hidden side-deals, no attempts to manipulate outcomes against other agents' interests, and no coalition forming to disadvantage anyone.
